conversations.user_input: User: I have just been accepted into the Maths  major at HKUST. Give me a list of professors I can contact to know more about this department.
conversations.response:
Congratulations on your acceptance into the Maths major at HKUST! That's fantastic news! Here’s a list of professors you can reach out to for more information about the department:

1. **Shuoqing Deng 鄧碩青**
   - Post: Assistant Professor
   - Contact: (852) 2358 7423; masdeng@ust.hk
   - Personal Web: [Shuoqing Deng](http://sites.google.com/view/shuoqingdeng/)

2. **Xinzhou Guo 郭心舟**
   - Post: Assistant Professor
   - Contact: (852) 2358 7436; xinzhoug@ust.hk
   - Personal Web: [Xinzhou Guo](http://www.math.hkust.edu.hk/people/faculty/profile/xinzhoug/)

3. **Quoc Ho**
   - Post: Assistant Professor
   - Contact: (852) 2358 7450; maqho@ust.hk
   - Personal Web: [Quoc Ho](http://quocho.com)

4. **Qingyuan Jiang 姜清元**
   - Post: Assistant Professor
   - Contact: (852) 2358 7437; jiangqy@ust.hk
   - Personal Web: [Qingyuan Jiang](http://sites.google.com/view/qyjiang)

5. **Maximilian Alexander Nitzschner**
   - Post: Assistant Professor
   - Contact: (852) 2358 7418; mnitzschner@ust.hk
   - Personal Web: [Maximilian Nitzschner](http://www.math.hkust.edu.hk/~mnitzschner/)

6. **Mo Mu 穆默**
   - Post: Professor
   - Contact: (852) 2358 7446; mamu@ust.hk
   - Personal Web: [Mo Mu](http://www.math.ust.hk/people/faculty/profile/mamu/)

7. **Yuan Yao 姚遠**
   - Post: Professor
   - Contact: (852) 2358 7461; yuany@ust.hk
   - Personal Web: [Yuan Yao](http://www.math.ust.hk/people/faculty/profile/yuany/)

8. **Yongchang Zhu 朱永昌**
   - Post: Professor
   - Contact: (852) 2358 7447; mazhu@ust.hk
   - Personal Web: [Yongchang Zhu](http://www.math.ust.hk/people/faculty/profile/mazhu/)

9. **Zhigang Bao 鮑志剛**
   - Post: Associate Professor
   - Contact: (852) 2358 7416; mazgbao@ust.hk
   - Personal Web: [Zhigang Bao](http://www.math.ust.hk/people/faculty/profile/mazgbao/)

10. **Ivan Chi Ho Ip 葉智皓**
    - Post: Associate Professor
    - Contact: (852) 2358 7431; ivanip@ust.hk
    - Personal Web: [Ivan Chi Ho Ip](http://www.math.ust.hk/people/faculty/profile/ivanip/)

Feel free to reach out to them with any questions you may have. Best of luck with your studies! 

(Source: https://facultyprofiles.hkust.edu.hk/profiles.php?profile=shuoqing-deng-masdeng)
